discovery.problem: API de librería para catálogo y ventas — Parcial de Programación III (Unidades 1 a 4): fundamentos de FastAPI, contratos y CRUD, ejecución asíncrona sin bloqueos, persistencia relacional con SQLModel y PostgreSQL, y despliegue en imagen Docker sobre VPS.

recommended.name: fastapi-python
recommended.why: OpenCode-compatible FastAPI backend guidance: typed routes, Pydantic v2, async operations, modular routers — matches the FastAPI + SQLAlchemy async core stack.

recommended.name: fastapi-expert
recommended.why: Production-grade FastAPI with async Python, Pydantic V2 validation, JWT auth and async DB operations; 12.3K-star source repo.

recommended.name: sqlalchemy-postgres
recommended.why: SQLAlchemy 2.0 async with asyncpg driver, PostgreSQL only, Alembic migrations — exact match to the persistence stack (SQLAlchemy 2.0 async, asyncpg, PostgreSQL 16).

recommended.name: postgresql
recommended.why: PostgreSQL best practices: schema design, Alembic migrations, async SQLAlchemy, query optimization — supports the PostgreSQL 16 data layer (under 100 installs, review before use).

recommended.name: production-docker
recommended.why: Production Docker hardening with multi-stage builds and a Python 3.12-slim example — matches python:3.12-alpine and needs_infra=true.

recommended.name: docker-deploy
recommended.why: Docker and deployment patterns with a Python (FastAPI/Flask/Django) template, multi-stage Alpine builds and health checks — matches docker alpine + VPS deploy.

recommended.name: vps-deploy
recommended.why: Full VPS deployment: SSH hardening, firewall, Docker, Nginx reverse proxy, SSL, health verification — matches despliegue VPS / needs_infra=true.
